paragraph.text: This block scrolls inside the chest screen without the server. Drag the text or the bar on the right, or use the mouse wheel on PC. The bar sits 2 px from the right edge and is 4 px wide. The thumb height follows the ratio of the view to the content. The server never learns the scroll position. Only a press on a slot button inside the list reaches it, like the rows on the left. Ore UI can keep a scroll pinned to the end while content grows. That option is not shown here.
